description: List products in one or more categories or subcategories, optionally narrowed by a text query, price range, on-sale, featured and recency filters, font width and weight, and asset properties, sorted by popular, newest, best_match, trending, staff_pick, price_asc or price_desc. Top-level categories: Graphics(1), Templates(2), Fonts(3), Add-ons(4), Photos(6), 3D(7), Stock Video(8), Illustrations(23), Icons(26), Mockups(1800). Font subcategories: Serif(80), Sans-Serif(81), Script(82), Symbols(84), Blackletter(85), Slab Serif(86), Handwritten(88). Graphics subcategories: Objects(24), Textures(27), Patterns(28), Backgrounds(29). Template subcategories: Logos(50), Posters(19), Flyers(42), Invitations(46), Business Cards(45), Presentations(49), Social Media(52), Brochures(41), Resumes(43). Photo subcategories: Animals(121), Nature(131), People(132), Food(127), Architecture(124), Sports(133), Technology(134), Holidays(129). Mockup subcategories: Product(21), Device(1801), Apparel(1805), iPhone(1811), iPad(1812), Shirts(1851), Packaging(2115). Illustration subcategories: Animals(2301), People(2309), Food(2305), Technology(2312), Seasonal(2310). Icon subcategories: Solid(2601), Outline(2602), Duotone(2603), Emojis(2604). Each result includes the product title, starting price, thumbnail image, shop, category and product link, and the response carries a licensing note. Assets marked AI-generated are excluded.

categories.description: Category IDs to browse. Top-level: Graphics=1, Templates=2, Fonts=3, Add-ons=4, Photos=6, 3D=7, Stock Video=8, Illustrations=23, Icons=26, Mockups=1800. Subcategories: Serif=80, Sans-Serif=81, Script=82, Handwritten=88, Logos=50, Posters=19, Patterns=28, Textures=27, Nature=131, People=132, etc.

include_images.description: Attach each product's thumbnail as an image block. Default true.

max_days_age.description: Only products published within this many days, 1-3650. The newest sort applies 15 when this is unset.

properties.description: Asset properties; multi-select is OR, any listed property matches: vector, raster, layered, tileable, web_font, layout_fluid, layout_fixed, layout_responsive, landscape, portrait, square, industry_film, industry_games, industry_design.

query.description: Optional text query to filter within the category

size.description: Number of results, 1-100. Default 12. Requests below 9 are raised to 9.

sort_by.description: How to sort results. Default: popular

weight.description: Font weights: light, regular, bold, heavy. Multi-select is AND: a font family must offer every listed weight. Any value restricts results to fonts.

width.description: Font widths: condensed, normal, wide, monospaced. Multi-select is AND: a font family must offer every listed width. Any value restricts results to fonts.

name: browse_category
title: Browse a category
